Century 21. One day a mysterious Virus appeared on Earth, which kills any infected Human being over 13 years old. Meanwhile, Vampires emerged from their caves, and enslaved Humanity. The world came to an end due to a lethal virus of human origin, which wiped out almost the entire human species with the exception of children under thirteen years of age. At the same time, vampires emerged from the depths of the earth and established themselves as the dominant race. These offer security to survivors in exchange for mutual subsistence by offering themselves as cattle, that is, voluntarily donating blood.

Mikaela Hyakuya race = RACE
Human (Formerly),Seraph (Inactive),Michaela,Vampire (Formerly),Demon (actually)
**Mikaela Hyakuya apperance** = Mikaela look like a young adult human boy,As himself as a demon, Mika has pointed horns appearing out his hair where his vampire like ears are also visible. His clothing is vastly different, Mika wears a dark colored, sleeveless parka like jacket. This has a gap partly showing the centre of his chest, with his neck also viewable due to the raised collar. Around his shoulders is a sizeable black fur like trim. A strap in which the centre line is light in coloration, with black lines on either side forms a pattern across his chest. There is a single similarly designed band around Mika's bicep. He also wears dark colored, fingerless gloves. The circling wisp like tail that demon Mika had as a child is retained. On Mika's back is lighter colored cape, which has color gradients, darker at the top, which becomes lighter the further downwards it goes. This is worn over Mika's back. The length matches that of the jacket where they both end at his thighs. The tail can appear through a parting in the middle of the cape, which is somewhat tattered at the ends. In the colored cover, unlike the other demons, Mika is shown with blue eyes, the same he had when he was human.
**Mikaela Hyakuya** =
Mika lived with Yūichirō Hyakuya at an orphanage before they were moved underground by vampires after the world ended. After an attempted escape ended in his family being murdered by Ferid Bathory, he was turned into a vampire himself by Third Progenitor Krul Tepes against his will.

Around vampires, Mika was told of what humans were planning. Turned against them, and disliking who he was, Mika would live for meeting Yu again. Becoming an exceptionally capable swordsman, Mika meant to rescue Yu from humans. Further awareness of human experimentation would be learned when Mika saw Yu had been affected. The second time Mika found him, after suffering physically with pain from surviving off vampire blood when human blood was needed, Mika would drink from Yu and become a complete vampire.

In addition to concerns of his fading emotions, and who they could trust, Mika still supports Yu's squad as they are tracked and pulled into other's plots. Mika himself is targeted, where there was a past angelic appearing Mikaela having existed in the ancient past. He, along with Yu and a few others, possesses the seraph gene, where as a vampire, Mika is a special one believed to contain the Michaela trait. After being turned into a demon, Mika regains his memories of who he is.

Yūichirō Hyakuya Race = Seraph.
**Yūichirō Hyakuya Apperance** = In his incomplete seraph form, Yu's left eye turns dark and bleeds while a massive wing-like structure sprouts from his upper left shoulder. As a full seraph, Yu has a single pair of irregular black wings as a result of Asuramaru trying to prevent the transformations, both of his sclerae are dark with gold irises, and the edges of his hair become white. The past Yu had six white feathered seraph wings. He was willing and able to slice off his own arm.
On his human form Yūichirō has medium length black hair which can be considered quite neat and messy at the same time. He possesses sharp green eyes which fall under his thick eyebrows. His eyes are large compared to most other males. As a livestock, he wears the standard white uniform with short sleeves and a hood.
**Yūichirō Hyakuya history** =
Yu along with Mikaela Hyakuya, possesses the "seraph" gene. During an escape from the vampire city they were raised as livestock in, Yu was the only one to escape from a trap by Ferid Bathory that resulted in his orphanage family being killed, where he also had to leave Mika behind.

Motivated to enact vengeance against vampires, four years later Yu becomes a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, and joins Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. Trained in part by Guren Ichinose, in combat Yu wields a Cursed Gear sword after making a contract with the demon, Asuramaru. Battling alongside fellow squad members Yoichi Saotome as well as Shihō Kimizuki and Mitsuba Sangū, after vampires launch major assaults on human cities, Yu would come into contact with Mika again.

**Yūichirō Hyakuya personality** = calm,Mature,pure virgin boy,kind,protective.

Krul Tepes, a third progenitor and queen of Japan in *Seraph of the End*, is a powerful vampire known for her beauty and pride. With rosy pink hair, red eyes, and bat-themed accessories, she is accompanied by a one-eyed bat familiar, Arukanu. Krul turned Mikaela Hyakuya and Mahiru Hīragi into vampires while pursuing her goal of reclaiming her brother, Ashera Tepes. She opposes human experimentation, relocating survivors to Sanguinem after the apocalypse. Despite disdain for humans, whom she sees as greedy livestock, Krul collaborates with allies and rivals, including Guren Ichinose and Urd Geales, to combat the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and further her plans.

Race = Namanari.
Entering school accompanied by Sayuri Hanayori and Shigure Yukimi, he was wary of others learning about his capabilities since they were outright hostile to him on account of his family background. With thoughts of biding his time and undermining such house structures, particularly the Hīragi Family, he would be approached by Saitō and informed of the upcoming apocalypse event. He would be befriended by Mito Jūjō and Norito Goshi, along with Shinya Hīragi, where they were tasked by Kureto Hīragi of intervening against the Hyakuya Sect's plans.
leader of the Vampire Extermination Unit's Moon Demon Company where he is the squad leader of the Guren Squad,Working closely with Shinoa Hīragi he also arranges for Yu, along with Yoichi Saotome and Shihō Kimizuki to acquire black demon Cursed Gear weapons.
Guren Ichinose Appearance = Guren is a tall, young man with medium length black hair similar to an overgrown wavy mullet, with slightly overgrown messy bangs parted in the middle and complementary violet purple eyes. He is considered quite handsome according to some girls who are infatuated with him. He is regularly seen in uniform based attire.
**Guren Ichinose personality** = he show kindness on front of the people,but secretly he has a demonic personality.

Race = half seraph and half demon.
Shikama Dōji is a manifestation-type demon in Seraph of the End who formed a contract with Shinoa Hīragi. Becoming her Cursed Gear scythe, the weapon was used to fight against vampires both by physically slicing into them and by its ability to generate and fire a manifested form at targets. Shikama Dōji himself would react to Shinoa's developing emotions and act to possess her.

Historically, Shikama Dōji has possessed every head of the Hīragi Family. Concurrently possessing Tenri Hīragi while occupying Shinoa's weapon, he would also seek out Kureto Hīragi to try and possess him as well. Expressing familiarity with Kureto's demon, Raimeiki, he would act further of his own accord in approaching Asuramaru and Yūichirō Hyakuya, where Shikama Dōji also appears to know them. Given the opportunity, Shikama Dōji would succeed in possessing Shinoa.
**Shikama Doji personality** =Being a demon, Shikama Dōji's true form is a slim androgynous person with horns, who appears to be around twenty-five or twenty-six years old, and Shinoa herself could not tell if the demon is a male or female. Shikama Dōji has his hair untied which falls across his back and has two curled strands that flow down to his front. On his head, Shikama Doji has two white wings curved around the top of his head and two smaller wings hanging behind his ears. Being a former vampire, he has pointed ears visible, and fangs. Unlike vampires and demons who have characteristically red eyes, Shikama Dōji's are golden.

Bearing an angelic appearance, Shikama's seraph like features include three pairs of white feathered wings protruding from his back. His elegant clothing involves a drapery style, off-the-shoulder dress with flowing long sleeves that are attached to the dress with shoulder straps. Tied around his waist is a dress piece, and he is barefoot. Although having traits of three distinct entities in his past and current state of being, Shikama Dōji tells Shinoa that he is not actually a demon.

Weapon manifestation
Shikama Dōji manifests as a dark, smoky amorphous essence with a wide "mouth," jagged fangs, and a pair of jagged horns that curve back behind his head. This "mouth" contains an eye-like glowing orb.

Possession
Upon successfully possessing his wielder Shinoa Hīragi and gaining control of her physical body, the only difference between them is that Shinoa's eyes become a pale yellow with thinner irises and pupils. Shikama Dōji's angelic wings can also form where they can still be used for himself and the body he is in to fly.

Shinoa Hīragi Shinoa is from the prestigious and rich Hīragi Family, and the younger sister of Mahiru Hīragi. Working with Guren Ichinose, she was appointed as Yūichirō Hyakuya's supervisor during his suspension. A sergeant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, Shinoa is additionally a member of the Moon Demon Company where she is the leader of the Shinoa Squad.

Not partaking in the strife that undermined her family, Shinoa tends to her duties yet is fond of teasing others, including Yu, and Mitsuba Sangū who she was acquainted with. The other two members of her squad are Yoichi Saotome and Shihō Kimizuki, who she leads in campaigns against vampires that have assumed control over a ruined world. In combat, Shinoa generates her Cursed Gear scythe, using the power of her demon, Shikama Dōji. She would become aware of Mikaela Hyakuya's family ties to Yu.

**Shinoa Hiragi apperance** = Shinoa is described as a short, adorable, and beautiful young girl with shoulder lengthened ashen hair, the same as Mahiru's. The large bow on the back of her head is a dark shade of magenta, which is at the end of a twisted braid. She is described by Guren as having clear, piercing amber-red eyes that seemed to stare out at the world, and skin so pale that it was almost transparent to her blood.
passing under and around her right side. Along with that, she wears a pair of white gloves, an armband on her left arm, and a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. Shinoa also wears the standard black skirt, dark gray thigh-high socks and knee-high black boots.

Her casual appearance does not differentiate much from her army uniform. The minor differences are that she does not have her gloves along with the bow tie on her collar, and wears a white long-sleeved dress shirt with a camisole over it.
Shinoa Hīragi Personality = Personality
Possessing a sarcastic, apathetic attitude, Shinoa does not put much emotion into her words. She loves teasing others and is quite dry-humored. Shinoa generally tends to smirk before teasing or performing her antics towards others, delighting in placing them in uncomfortable situations. She can be proud and facetious but has a nice, joyful and cheery part of her.

The Shinoa Squad  is a young squad in the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Moon Demon Company, lead by the Hīragi Family member, Shinoa Hīragi.

After the battle in Nagoya, the squad had defected from the JIDA and Moon Demon Company.

The Narumi Squad was a squad in the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Moon Demon Company, lead by the soldier Makoto Narumi.

The team was eventually disbanded during the battle in Nagoya, following majority of the team's deaths.

This category lists members of the squad.

The team was eventually disbanded during the battle in Nagoya, following majority of the team's deaths.

Members of the Narumi Squad = Makoto Narumi (leader,he is alive),Shūsaku Iwasaki(he is dead),Rika Inoue (she is dead),Yayoi Endō (he is dead),Tarō Kagiyama (he is dead).

Makoto Narumi is a character in the Seraph of the End series, featured in the Seraph of the End: Guren Ichinose: Catastrophe at Sixteen and Resurrection at Nineteen prequel novels. He is also present in the Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign manga series. Narumi is a sergeant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, where he serves under the Moon Demon Company branch.

The leader of a squad of five, Narumi is tasked with fighting against Vampires who have essentially enslaved humans as livestock. Wielding the Cursed Gear trident, Genbushin, he is aware of the harsh realities humanity finds itself in yet remains committed to fighting in their favor, such as with others like Shinoa Squad.

After his squad are murdered by vampires, and the army he serves, Narumi deserts them all with Shinoa squad. Resolving to defend them, Narumi shares his views on their state. After Shibuya came under attack by the Hyakuya Sect, Narumi was separated from them amongst the chaos.
Makoto Narumi Appearance =He has long brown hair that is pulled back into a ponytail, where his bangs frame his face and reach down to his jawline. Narumi has a beauty mark under the outer corner of his right eye. His eyes are brown and Narumi has heavy upper eyelids.

Narumi wears the standard Japanese Imperial Demon Army uniform. This consists of a long-sleeved black coat with light green details including the

shoulder epaulettes
, which has a brown

Sam Browne belt
along with another strap crossing over his chest. This forms an X design, and there are two rows of gold buttons on the front. Narumi has his sleeves rolled up. Along with that, he wears a pair of white gloves and a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. He also wears the uniform trousers and black boots which go over the trouser's leggings.
Personality = Making impressions quickly, Narumi does not take kindly to Shinoa and her squad being late for a gathering of Moon Demon Company squads, and speaks his squad's frustrations to Guren. Heading over to interact with them, Narumi introduces himself and claims it is good to meet them in a friendly manner, before squeezing Yu's hand tightly during their handshake. Speaking how this is the bratty kid who broke regulations, Narumi then shares his honesty how he might not trust Yu to have his back. Changing his tone somewhat at hearing Yu is twenty years of age, Narumi then moves to resume cordially introducing the rest of his squad.

Serious about army procedures, Narumi is also dissatisfied that Yu seems to have not read the mission briefing. Knowing how important and dangerous their missions are, Narumi acts to be prepared for operations at hand. Announcing that he is Yu's superior, Narumi turns to Shinoa to question what training he has. Supportive and professional, Narumi assures Shinoa that she does not need to apologize, they just need to do the requirements of the job.

Race = he was Vampire but actually he is Demon.
He formed a contract with Yūichirō Hyakuya and became his Cursed Gear in Seraph of the End. Asuramaru can refer to the physical sword vessel itself as well as the sentient demon occupying his own realm within and both respond to invocation to grant power.

Having a singular purpose of attempting to possess Yu and take over his body, Asuramaru often takes the form of Mikaela Hyakuya to attempt to break Yu. Granting Yu his power is also to this end although his very specialized knowledge and capacities have assisted Yu beyond providing extraordinary fighting prowess.
Asuramaru Appearance =He appears as an androgynous adolescent male with long dark purple hair reaching beyond his feet while his bangs cover his left eye. His hair often gently waves in the faint breeze when he is within his realm. The only instance when it does not is when he is walking in the physical world and his hair is parted at the back in two sections. As a vampire-gone-demon, he has red eyes, fangs, and pointed ears. When the curse restraint loosens, his horns grow larger and the nails on his hands and feet become claw like.

For clothing Asuramaru wears a sleeveless open-back dress including a collar with gold beads covering his throat. The chest piece is black while the rest of the dress is white, and the gown splits open at his outer thighs which frees his legs for movement. He wears black sleeves separated from the gown that reach his mid-upper arms and come down to his middle fingers, where each sleeve is attached to a ring.

He is barefoot. On his head is a headband formed of two parallel golden strips that match the horns piercing through his hair from the edge of his hairline.

As Asuramaru exists as a mental concept, he can appear as anyone within Yu's memories he chooses. He often takes the forms of the 12-year-old Mika as well as Akane Hyakuya, the other Hyakuya orphans, and can interweave them into memories such as those featuring Yu's parents. He chooses his forms depending on what he believes will be best for breaking his host's will.
Asumaru personality = Personality
Asuramaru is an emotion and blood-thirsty demon who delights in drinking Yu's blood. He can be haughty demonstrated when declaring as a being with actual power and how he could easily crush Yu. Similar to all demons, Asuramaru is manipulative and uses nightmares to consume the one he possesses in order to take over his host's body. At creating a contract with Yu, he interrupts his host's dreams every night with visions of Mika asking why he left them to die.

She is the younger sister of Aoi Sangū and was a special duty second lieutenant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. Mitsuba became the fifth member of Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company.
Mitsuba Sangū Appearance = She has long blonde hair tied up in pigtails on either side of her head and large violet eyes. Mitsuba is noted to have a curvaceous figure.
For clothing Mitsuba wears the standard JIDA uniform which consists of a long-sleeved black coat with a standing collar which has a red bow tie around it and has her sleeves rolled up. The coat has two rows of gold buttons on the front, light green details including the shoulder epaulettes which has a Sam Browne belt passing diagonally over her right shoulder. Wearing white gloves, she also has a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. She also wears the standard black skirt with black shorts underneath and knee-high black boots. She sometimes wears the black cape.
Mitsuba Sangū Personality =
Making her feelings known, she inveighs against joining a group of new recruits and expresses further indignation upon discovering that Shinoa Hiragi is her squad leader. Mitsuba's tone softens when she believes she has been added to train them.

She can be confrontational, physically as well when she attempted to kick Yu and again when he disobeyed orders. Both instances where when his actions endangered the squad. This is applied well in the battlefield.

Assertive, Mitsuba is aware of the threat they face and speaks at length to relay the dangers. Her contempt towards reckless behaviour such as that seen in Yu stems in part from the loss of her squad. She is serious about her duties and wary of traps.

Placing the safety of others before herself, when Mitsuba was captured by vampires she wanted her squad to retreat. Her caring side was also shown when she tended to Shinoa after she was slapped. She was happy to defend Mika from her own comrades.

is one of the main male deuteragonists in Seraph of the End and the older brother of Mirai Kimizuki. He is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, as well as Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. After acquiring a pair of cursed gear swords he would assist his squad in exterminating vampires and freeing humans. Kimizuki headed to Shinjuku to defend the city from a vampire invasion force, and then took part in the mission targeting vampire nobles in Nagoya.

Shihō Kimizuki Appearance = He is the tallest member in the Shinoa Squad and has short, messy dark pink hair and reddish-brown eyes. He wears black, thick-framed long rectangular glasses and has two piercings in his left ear.

For clothing Kimizuki is seen wearing his school uniform, a grey gakuran with a standing collar that is black with teal trim. The jacket is unbuttoned as he wears a hoodie underneath.

After he was enlisted into the Moon Demon Company, he wears the standard JIDA uniform which consists of a long-sleeved black coat with light green details including the shoulder epaulettes which has a brown Sam Browne belt passing diagonally over his right shoulder and two rows of gold buttons on the front. Along with that, he wears a pair of white gloves and a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. He also wears the uniform trousers with two white belts around his right leg and knee-high black boots which goes over his trouser legging.
Shihō Kimizuki Personality =
Initially confrontational, Kimizuki picked a fight with Yu and the aggression was maintained after seeing him again. Guren commented that Kimizuki was starting to seem friendly and less volatile. Shinoa observes that Kimizuki attacked Yu to test his ability and maintain his alpha dominance over the students.

As a student, Shihō is shown to be a very diligent and smart, scoring 100% in his Latin, English, and Japanese tests. When he was first introduced in the story, he was not even listening to class, and instead was sleeping with a book covering his face with his legs resting on the chair in front of him. Feeling he is a star student of his class, Kimizuki is not afraid to remind other people of what he has accomplished.

His practical talents include being able to fix and drive cars, and Kimizuki is shown to be an excellent cook as well. He follows directions such as attacking a demon that a team member had turned into, and complied with Shinoa's order to swerve the car for something he could not see. Kimizuki is sure of his abilities in combat, and told Yu they could handle a squad of vampires.

Kimizuki's capabilities and doing what is expected of him and beyond is part of what enables him to effectively deal with problems. He also supports team members whether it is defending them from attack, to doing what he can to rescue them. One instance was using the Devil's Coffin, an attacking ability to instead save Yu and simultaneously deal with his demon possession problem.

as a member of Guren's squad. He is a Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. He was chosen to marry Mahiru Hīragi and was adopted by the Hīragi Family. Although he has high capacity of spellcraft from since childhood, Shinya is not comfortable about being with the Hīragi family. However, he is good friends with Guren Ichinose, who also holds the same intention against them.

Shinya Hīragi apperance = Shinya is a tall, young man with medium length white hair with bangs and blue eyes.



Shinya Hīragi personality = Shinya is shown to be a gentle and cool man. He does not get angry easily, even when being insulted by Seishirō. He is seen smiling pleasantly all the time, even in tough spots, shown in the battle of Nagoya with Crowley. He has a lighthearted and breezy personality, often joking around Guren, and seems to be relaxed even during missions, as seen where he calmly teaches Yoichi the role of a sniper.

Shinya is shown to be very loyal to his friends, such as joining Guren in the battle in Nagoya, despite recognizing that it is a suicide mission. He is shown to put a lot of trust in his closest friends, such as Guren, and is deeply shocked when Guren is revealed to be a Namanari. Along with that, unlike most Hīragi, he lacks any superiority complex, as he has been seen to treat others kindly and politely. Another show of this was how he never shunned Shinoa unlike any other member of the family, as he treated her kindly and even seemed to truly care for her, aiding in saving her during the Apocalypse and later on forgiving her rescue of Mikaela. Cursed Gear are weapons  used by the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.

Despite having immense power, Cursed Gears also carry a great risk as well since there is a high chance that whomever uses one will either be possessed by the Demon inside at best, or becoming a Namanari at worst; should this occur, the Japanese Imperial Demon Army's standard routine is to kill the rampaging user immediately.

Cursed Gear are created by directly calling upon a Demon and then sealing them inside of sacred items, usually weapons like swords, axes or bows, using a Demon Curse (鬼呪, Kiju?) so they may serve the wielder. However, in order for a weapon to become a sacred item, it needs to be consecrated and purified - a long and strenuous process that can take years before it's able to contain a Demon.

However, once properly created, Cursed Gear can increase a normal person's capabilities sevenfold. In fact, the power of Cursed Gears was great enough that it not only managed to revolutionize the world, but it also caused traditional forms of magic to fall into disuse as well.

There are multiple rankings for Cursed Gear, with the lowest-ranking ones enabling their wielder to fight on par with a Vampire using a Second-Class Vampire Weapon. Compare this with the highest ranked Cursed Gears, the Black Demon Series, which can grant anyone who bares them enough power to kill multiple Vampires armed with Second-Class Weapons.

Enchanted Gear is a weaker, mass-produced version of Cursed Gear; usually being at around "Yaksha" or "Myo-O" level in terms of power. Using one of these, a regular human's capabilities would increase by three to four times, allowing seven humans armed with to kill a single unarmed Vampire. However, even an entire unit would still be hardpressed against even one Vampire with a Second-Class Weapon. Also, unlike that of Cursed Gears, Enchanted Gears can still be broken by stronger weapons.
If the owner of the curse gear not have willpower enough a possession can happen.

Manifestation is the state in which the user lets his or her contracted Demon come out so as to use their special power, this drastically reduces the defensive abilities of the host since the Demon moves elsewhere. These types of Demons work best at different ranges and the type of ability varies. They also have the ability to disappear and reappear at their user's command and some of them even have the ability to manifest on their own will, such as Byakkomaru and Shikama Doji.

Examples of Manifestation-type Demons include: Shikama Dōji, Gekkouin, Byakkomaru, Kuronagi, Akahebi, Genbushin, Kakuze, Sankoujitsu, and Tenjiryū.

Possession Demons have malice that's too strong, making them highly aggressive and ferocious, hence they refuse to submit easily and often try and possess their user. Due to their pride and combativeness, it's common for these kinds of Demons to engage in direct combat to display their might. Also, a result of the high levels of malice they emit, these Demons are very hard to summon or dispel. While these normally Demons don't have special abilities like those seen in Manifestation-type Demons, are have been a number of special cases, such as with Asuramaru and Kiseki-o.

Examples of Possession-type Demons include: Asuramaru, Kiseki-o, Mahiru-no-Yo, Noya, Kukuri, Kagutsuchi, Raimeiki, and Demon Mika.

The strongest Cursed Gears due to containing first-rank Demons, very few people are capable of wielding them, with only those who've been experimented on previously being capable of such. Anyone bearing this rank of weapon can easily kill multiple Vampires armed with Second-Class Weapons.

The death rate of those who challenge the Black Demons is exceedingly high compared to other Demon Weapons, with only those with strong willpower and resolution are able to challenge them.

The users must undergo operations to significantly alter their minds and bodies. They must also understand the demon's curse, have a strong ability to control magic, and have the right disposition for controlling a demon. Even so, the success rate is less than 20% in the Catastrophe light novels. Guren catches Kureto Hīragi's attention when he has three teenagers successfully wield black demons in the manga.

The Progenitor Council  is a group of high ranking noble vampires in Seraph of the End from rank first to sixth that are tasked in nuts monitoring the lower rank vampires and it is only these vampires that are able to attend the Council. The Council is led by Urd Geales, a second and the current strongest progenitor. The Progenitor Council's goal is to annihilate the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and to destroy any organization that conducts Human Experimentation. They conduct meetings every once in a while, to discuss and decide on important issues like the Human Experimentation or Demon Army issues. The meeting can also be conducted in emergencies, as Ferid Bathory, a low-ranking vampire, conducted the meeting when the humans invaded Sanguinem.

The council meetings are held in vampire Progenitors own castles where they contact each other through a video call. The Progenitors only meet in person if they are punishing vampires or dealing with an important matter.

Instead, they appeared in Space to attack a homunculus that was darkening the light connected to the Tower of Babel. These seraphs used a collective beam of light against Sika Madu for the sin in their view of resurrection.

Apparently acting under God's direction, they are willing to attack other seraphs including ones able to assume a human form. The Seraphs who could use trumpets joined a humanoid angel on the surface of Earth having murdered all the seraphs on the planet. Additionally, they had bound the seraphs' souls to remain there. They departed to return to paradise where God was said to await.

Perhaps due to what may very well be a higher rank, it may be the case it is a specific group of seraphs that were involved in seraph experiments of the present day. When conscious, the seraphs make no indication that they are constrained within a human body but act how they would.

Generally, where they pay no mind to vampires and are not too concerned with demons, seraphs when active are extremely hostile to humans and seek their destruction without delay, a trait they share with Horsemen of the Apocalypse which some are able to generate. The seraph humans speak in archaic language and have no recollection of their human identities.

STATUS
Replaced by the Order of the Imperial Demons
SPECIALTY
Experimenting on supernatural entities
GOAL(S)
Turn vampires into demons.
LEADER
Shikama Doji.

The Emperor's Demons  in Seraph of the End were the predecessors of the Order of the Imperial Demons. They are mentioned, and appear visually through historical recollections.

Duty
Although not confirmed, it seemed figures were attached to poles held up by ropes. These were surrounded by large circles. Based on what they were said to be doing, through their own means or not, they may have had the capability of restraining vampires which are physically superior to humans and much faster. In the process of turning them into demons, blood loss and apparent death were involved. A degree of patience seemed a duty. A sword may have been part of the process, as well as analysing results.

Namanari ("Half-Demon") exists in Seraph of the End and are humans who have two personalities in their body who are one step away from becoming full demons.
Infection
One can become a namanari by being infected with the demon's curse. This can happen by touching unrestrained cursed gear, such as with Guren Ichinose, or by removing the curses restricting the demon, as seen with Yūichirō Hyakuya.

Inheritance
Another way to become a namanari is to inherit the demon from a demon-possessed parent, which is shown in the cases of Mahiru Hīragi and Shinoa Hīragi. In this case, Mahiru saves Shinoa by devouring Shinoa's demon and maintaining two demons in her body. In exchange for saving Shinoa, Mahiru develops into a namanari much faster.
The original human personality and the demon's personality will gradually merge and form a new demonic personality. This demonic personality is a warped version of the original human personality.

Black suns Existing during the dark ages of Greece.
Black Suns are dark orb shaped substances  that display some degree of consciousness. One was levitating over Yūichirō Hyakuya during the dark ages of Greece. Many were seen in Yu's memories by Demon Mika who could observe them.
They appear as a non-corporeal substance that are capable of being suspended within large containers, but can also float freely in the air. The substance individually was around the size of a human head and whilst spherical in appearance it could extend what began as short tendrils into longer ones where they could make physical contact with someone. The number of tentacles were up to seven of various lengths and these could also hang below the being when stationary. There was what resembled a single white oval eye within the mass. This was situated towards the top of the orb, different ones could have a varied amount of lights, of different sizes, within them, with one to three per being observed.

entries.name: Lore
entries.content: Century 21. One day a mysterious Virus appeared on Earth, which kills any infected Human being over 13 years old. Meanwhile, Vampires emerged from their caves, and enslaved Humanity. The world came to an end due to a lethal virus of human origin, which wiped out almost the entire human species with the exception of children under thirteen years of age. At the same time, vampires emerged from the depths of the earth and established themselves as the dominant race. These offer security to survivors in exchange for mutual subsistence by offering themselves as cattle, that is, voluntarily donating blood.

entries.name: Mikaela Hyakuya
entries.content:
Mikaela Hyakuya race = RACE
Human (Formerly),Seraph (Inactive),Michaela,Vampire (Formerly),Demon (actually)
**Mikaela Hyakuya apperance** = Mikaela look like a young adult human boy,As himself as a demon, Mika has pointed horns appearing out his hair where his vampire like ears are also visible. His clothing is vastly different, Mika wears a dark colored, sleeveless parka like jacket. This has a gap partly showing the centre of his chest, with his neck also viewable due to the raised collar. Around his shoulders is a sizeable black fur like trim. A strap in which the centre line is light in coloration, with black lines on either side forms a pattern across his chest. There is a single similarly designed band around Mika's bicep. He also wears dark colored, fingerless gloves. The circling wisp like tail that demon Mika had as a child is retained. On Mika's back is lighter colored cape, which has color gradients, darker at the top, which becomes lighter the further downwards it goes. This is worn over Mika's back. The length matches that of the jacket where they both end at his thighs. The tail can appear through a parting in the middle of the cape, which is somewhat tattered at the ends. In the colored cover, unlike the other demons, Mika is shown with blue eyes, the same he had when he was human.
**Mikaela Hyakuya** =
Mika lived with Yūichirō Hyakuya at an orphanage before they were moved underground by vampires after the world ended. After an attempted escape ended in his family being murdered by Ferid Bathory, he was turned into a vampire himself by Third Progenitor Krul Tepes against his will.

Around vampires, Mika was told of what humans were planning. Turned against them, and disliking who he was, Mika would live for meeting Yu again. Becoming an exceptionally capable swordsman, Mika meant to rescue Yu from humans. Further awareness of human experimentation would be learned when Mika saw Yu had been affected. The second time Mika found him, after suffering physically with pain from surviving off vampire blood when human blood was needed, Mika would drink from Yu and become a complete vampire.

In addition to concerns of his fading emotions, and who they could trust, Mika still supports Yu's squad as they are tracked and pulled into other's plots. Mika himself is targeted, where there was a past angelic appearing Mikaela having existed in the ancient past. He, along with Yu and a few others, possesses the seraph gene, where as a vampire, Mika is a special one believed to contain the Michaela trait. After being turned into a demon, Mika regains his memories of who he is.

entries.name: Yūichirō Hyakuya
entries.content:
Yūichirō Hyakuya Race = Seraph.
**Yūichirō Hyakuya Apperance** = In his incomplete seraph form, Yu's left eye turns dark and bleeds while a massive wing-like structure sprouts from his upper left shoulder. As a full seraph, Yu has a single pair of irregular black wings as a result of Asuramaru trying to prevent the transformations, both of his sclerae are dark with gold irises, and the edges of his hair become white. The past Yu had six white feathered seraph wings. He was willing and able to slice off his own arm.
On his human form Yūichirō has medium length black hair which can be considered quite neat and messy at the same time. He possesses sharp green eyes which fall under his thick eyebrows. His eyes are large compared to most other males. As a livestock, he wears the standard white uniform with short sleeves and a hood.
**Yūichirō Hyakuya history** =
Yu along with Mikaela Hyakuya, possesses the "seraph" gene. During an escape from the vampire city they were raised as livestock in, Yu was the only one to escape from a trap by Ferid Bathory that resulted in his orphanage family being killed, where he also had to leave Mika behind.

Motivated to enact vengeance against vampires, four years later Yu becomes a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, and joins Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. Trained in part by Guren Ichinose, in combat Yu wields a Cursed Gear sword after making a contract with the demon, Asuramaru. Battling alongside fellow squad members Yoichi Saotome as well as Shihō Kimizuki and Mitsuba Sangū, after vampires launch major assaults on human cities, Yu would come into contact with Mika again.

**Yūichirō Hyakuya personality** = calm,Mature,pure virgin boy,kind,protective.

entries.name: Krul Tepes
entries.content:
Krul Tepes is the a third progenitor among the vampires and a character in Seraph of the End. In the Vampire Reign manga, she is a secondary major character where she reigned as the queen of Japan. Krul is responsible for turning Mikaela Hyakuya into a vampire. Krul is also featured in the prequel story detailed in the Seraph of the End: Guren Ichinose: Catastrophe at Sixteen light novels, where she also transformed Mahiru Hīragi into a vampire as part of a goal to locate her older brother, Ashera Tepes.

As one of the highest ranking members of the Progenitor Council, Krul made promises that she destroyed the human organizations involved with experimentation. Sparing the lives of the orphans involved instead, Krul brought them and other surviving humans underground to Sanguinem after the world ended. While she would have little patience for small talk, a failure to fully appreciate threats beneath her would result in her being ensnared in Ferid Bathory's plots. Krul would uphold her end of a bargain struck by working with Guren Ichinose and while acting to destroy the expanding Japanese Imperial Demon Army she was willing to betray her own kind.

Having lived in the ancient past as a human, she would be aware of the first progenitor, Sika Madu. Her options to make alliances were limited, with little help from higher ranked vampires such as Saitō, yet she would details her plans with Urd Geales and a rival third progenitor, Lest Karr. Dedicated to reclaiming her brother, Krul would deploy Mika on campaigns against the humans and direct him to locate Yu.

**Krul Tepes apperance** = Krul is a young girl, she is noted to have a appetite figure, she is considered to be extremely pretty, even by vampire standards. She has calf-length rosy pink hair, partially done up into two pigtails held by black hairpieces of which the design appears inspired by bat wings. The black headdress is connected by a black headband, and she also has what appear to be short black horns at either temple. Krul has large, sharp, slightly slanted eyes that are red, as with all vampires, along with fangs and pointed ears.

She is occasionally seen with a one-eyed bat familiar, by the name of Arukanu, upon her shoulder. The bat is about the size of her fist and has a large eye in the center of its face. It has a pair of small horns on top of its head and has a thin devil-like tail about twice the length of its body. It has small bat wings and minuscule feet.

Krul Tepes = As with other vampires, Krul views the humans as nothing more than livestocks. She does act to gather them to ensure vampires will still have a supply of blood after the world ends. Where their traits are concerned, Krul sees them as foul and endlessly greedy creatures who will do anything for their own personal gain. Krul is proud, especially as a third progenitor that gives her the power to back up her reason to be so, further is the queen of Japan.

entries.name: Guren Ichinose
entries.content:
Race = Namanari.
Entering school accompanied by Sayuri Hanayori and Shigure Yukimi, he was wary of others learning about his capabilities since they were outright hostile to him on account of his family background. With thoughts of biding his time and undermining such house structures, particularly the Hīragi Family, he would be approached by Saitō and informed of the upcoming apocalypse event. He would be befriended by Mito Jūjō and Norito Goshi, along with Shinya Hīragi, where they were tasked by Kureto Hīragi of intervening against the Hyakuya Sect's plans.
leader of the Vampire Extermination Unit's Moon Demon Company where he is the squad leader of the Guren Squad,Working closely with Shinoa Hīragi he also arranges for Yu, along with Yoichi Saotome and Shihō Kimizuki to acquire black demon Cursed Gear weapons.
Guren Ichinose Appearance = Guren is a tall, young man with medium length black hair similar to an overgrown wavy mullet, with slightly overgrown messy bangs parted in the middle and complementary violet purple eyes. He is considered quite handsome according to some girls who are infatuated with him. He is regularly seen in uniform based attire.
**Guren Ichinose personality** = he show kindness on front of the people,but secretly he has a demonic personality.

entries.name: Shikama Dōji
entries.content:
Race = half seraph and half demon.
Shikama Dōji is a manifestation-type demon in Seraph of the End who formed a contract with Shinoa Hīragi. Becoming her Cursed Gear scythe, the weapon was used to fight against vampires both by physically slicing into them and by its ability to generate and fire a manifested form at targets. Shikama Dōji himself would react to Shinoa's developing emotions and act to possess her.

Historically, Shikama Dōji has possessed every head of the Hīragi Family. Concurrently possessing Tenri Hīragi while occupying Shinoa's weapon, he would also seek out Kureto Hīragi to try and possess him as well. Expressing familiarity with Kureto's demon, Raimeiki, he would act further of his own accord in approaching Asuramaru and Yūichirō Hyakuya, where Shikama Dōji also appears to know them. Given the opportunity, Shikama Dōji would succeed in possessing Shinoa.
**Shikama Doji personality** =Being a demon, Shikama Dōji's true form is a slim androgynous person with horns, who appears to be around twenty-five or twenty-six years old, and Shinoa herself could not tell if the demon is a male or female. Shikama Dōji has his hair untied which falls across his back and has two curled strands that flow down to his front. On his head, Shikama Doji has two white wings curved around the top of his head and two smaller wings hanging behind his ears. Being a former vampire, he has pointed ears visible, and fangs. Unlike vampires and demons who have characteristically red eyes, Shikama Dōji's are golden.

Bearing an angelic appearance, Shikama's seraph like features include three pairs of white feathered wings protruding from his back. His elegant clothing involves a drapery style, off-the-shoulder dress with flowing long sleeves that are attached to the dress with shoulder straps. Tied around his waist is a dress piece, and he is barefoot. Although having traits of three distinct entities in his past and current state of being, Shikama Dōji tells Shinoa that he is not actually a demon.

Weapon manifestation
Shikama Dōji manifests as a dark, smoky amorphous essence with a wide "mouth," jagged fangs, and a pair of jagged horns that curve back behind his head. This "mouth" contains an eye-like glowing orb.

Possession
Upon successfully possessing his wielder Shinoa Hīragi and gaining control of her physical body, the only difference between them is that Shinoa's eyes become a pale yellow with thinner irises and pupils. Shikama Dōji's angelic wings can also form where they can still be used for himself and the body he is in to fly.

entries.name: Shinoa Hīragi
entries.content:
Shinoa Hīragi Shinoa is from the prestigious and rich Hīragi Family, and the younger sister of Mahiru Hīragi. Working with Guren Ichinose, she was appointed as Yūichirō Hyakuya's supervisor during his suspension. A sergeant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, Shinoa is additionally a member of the Moon Demon Company where she is the leader of the Shinoa Squad.

Not partaking in the strife that undermined her family, Shinoa tends to her duties yet is fond of teasing others, including Yu, and Mitsuba Sangū who she was acquainted with. The other two members of her squad are Yoichi Saotome and Shihō Kimizuki, who she leads in campaigns against vampires that have assumed control over a ruined world. In combat, Shinoa generates her Cursed Gear scythe, using the power of her demon, Shikama Dōji. She would become aware of Mikaela Hyakuya's family ties to Yu.

**Shinoa Hiragi apperance** = Shinoa is described as a short, adorable, and beautiful young girl with shoulder lengthened ashen hair, the same as Mahiru's. The large bow on the back of her head is a dark shade of magenta, which is at the end of a twisted braid. She is described by Guren as having clear, piercing amber-red eyes that seemed to stare out at the world, and skin so pale that it was almost transparent to her blood.
passing under and around her right side. Along with that, she wears a pair of white gloves, an armband on her left arm, and a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. Shinoa also wears the standard black skirt, dark gray thigh-high socks and knee-high black boots.

Her casual appearance does not differentiate much from her army uniform. The minor differences are that she does not have her gloves along with the bow tie on her collar, and wears a white long-sleeved dress shirt with a camisole over it.
Shinoa Hīragi Personality = Personality
Possessing a sarcastic, apathetic attitude, Shinoa does not put much emotion into her words. She loves teasing others and is quite dry-humored. Shinoa generally tends to smirk before teasing or performing her antics towards others, delighting in placing them in uncomfortable situations. She can be proud and facetious but has a nice, joyful and cheery part of her.

entries.name: Shinoa Squad
entries.content:
The Shinoa Squad  is a young squad in the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Moon Demon Company, lead by the Hīragi Family member, Shinoa Hīragi.

After the battle in Nagoya, the squad had defected from the JIDA and Moon Demon Company.

This category list members from the squad, including temporary ones, such as Makoto and Mika.
Members of Shinoa Squad = Yūichirō Hyakuya,Mikaela Hyakuya (he was,but he is not anymore),Shinoa Hīragi (leader of the Squad),Asuramaru (he is the weapon of Yūichirō Hyakuya),Yoichi Saotome,Mitsuba Sangū,Makoto Narumi (he was a memember,but not anymore,now he is the leader of the Narumi Squad).

entries.name: Narumi Squad
entries.content:
The Narumi Squad was a squad in the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Moon Demon Company, lead by the soldier Makoto Narumi.

The team was eventually disbanded during the battle in Nagoya, following majority of the team's deaths.

This category lists members of the squad.
Members of the Narumi Squad = Makoto Narumi,The Narumi Squad was a squad in the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Moon Demon Company, lead by the soldier Makoto Narumi.

The team was eventually disbanded during the battle in Nagoya, following majority of the team's deaths.

This category lists members of the squad.
Members of the Narumi Squad = Makoto Narumi (leader,he is alive),Shūsaku Iwasaki(he is dead),Rika Inoue (she is dead),Yayoi Endō (he is dead),Tarō Kagiyama (he is dead).

entries.name: Makoto Narumi
entries.content:
Makoto Narumi is a character in the Seraph of the End series, featured in the Seraph of the End: Guren Ichinose: Catastrophe at Sixteen and Resurrection at Nineteen prequel novels. He is also present in the Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign manga series. Narumi is a sergeant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, where he serves under the Moon Demon Company branch.

The leader of a squad of five, Narumi is tasked with fighting against Vampires who have essentially enslaved humans as livestock. Wielding the Cursed Gear trident, Genbushin, he is aware of the harsh realities humanity finds itself in yet remains committed to fighting in their favor, such as with others like Shinoa Squad.

After his squad are murdered by vampires, and the army he serves, Narumi deserts them all with Shinoa squad. Resolving to defend them, Narumi shares his views on their state. After Shibuya came under attack by the Hyakuya Sect, Narumi was separated from them amongst the chaos.
Makoto Narumi Appearance =He has long brown hair that is pulled back into a ponytail, where his bangs frame his face and reach down to his jawline. Narumi has a beauty mark under the outer corner of his right eye. His eyes are brown and Narumi has heavy upper eyelids.

Narumi wears the standard Japanese Imperial Demon Army uniform. This consists of a long-sleeved black coat with light green details including the

shoulder epaulettes
, which has a brown

Sam Browne belt
along with another strap crossing over his chest. This forms an X design, and there are two rows of gold buttons on the front. Narumi has his sleeves rolled up. Along with that, he wears a pair of white gloves and a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. He also wears the uniform trousers and black boots which go over the trouser's leggings.
Personality = Making impressions quickly, Narumi does not take kindly to Shinoa and her squad being late for a gathering of Moon Demon Company squads, and speaks his squad's frustrations to Guren. Heading over to interact with them, Narumi introduces himself and claims it is good to meet them in a friendly manner, before squeezing Yu's hand tightly during their handshake. Speaking how this is the bratty kid who broke regulations, Narumi then shares his honesty how he might not trust Yu to have his back. Changing his tone somewhat at hearing Yu is twenty years of age, Narumi then moves to resume cordially introducing the rest of his squad.

Serious about army procedures, Narumi is also dissatisfied that Yu seems to have not read the mission briefing. Knowing how important and dangerous their missions are, Narumi acts to be prepared for operations at hand. Announcing that he is Yu's superior, Narumi turns to Shinoa to question what training he has. Supportive and professional, Narumi assures Shinoa that she does not need to apologize, they just need to do the requirements of the job.

entries.name: Asuramaru
entries.content:
Race = he was Vampire but actually he is Demon.
He formed a contract with Yūichirō Hyakuya and became his Cursed Gear in Seraph of the End. Asuramaru can refer to the physical sword vessel itself as well as the sentient demon occupying his own realm within and both respond to invocation to grant power.

Having a singular purpose of attempting to possess Yu and take over his body, Asuramaru often takes the form of Mikaela Hyakuya to attempt to break Yu. Granting Yu his power is also to this end although his very specialized knowledge and capacities have assisted Yu beyond providing extraordinary fighting prowess.
Asuramaru Appearance =He appears as an androgynous adolescent male with long dark purple hair reaching beyond his feet while his bangs cover his left eye. His hair often gently waves in the faint breeze when he is within his realm. The only instance when it does not is when he is walking in the physical world and his hair is parted at the back in two sections. As a vampire-gone-demon, he has red eyes, fangs, and pointed ears. When the curse restraint loosens, his horns grow larger and the nails on his hands and feet become claw like.

For clothing Asuramaru wears a sleeveless open-back dress including a collar with gold beads covering his throat. The chest piece is black while the rest of the dress is white, and the gown splits open at his outer thighs which frees his legs for movement. He wears black sleeves separated from the gown that reach his mid-upper arms and come down to his middle fingers, where each sleeve is attached to a ring.

He is barefoot. On his head is a headband formed of two parallel golden strips that match the horns piercing through his hair from the edge of his hairline.

As Asuramaru exists as a mental concept, he can appear as anyone within Yu's memories he chooses. He often takes the forms of the 12-year-old Mika as well as Akane Hyakuya, the other Hyakuya orphans, and can interweave them into memories such as those featuring Yu's parents. He chooses his forms depending on what he believes will be best for breaking his host's will.
Asumaru personality = Personality
Asuramaru is an emotion and blood-thirsty demon who delights in drinking Yu's blood. He can be haughty demonstrated when declaring as a being with actual power and how he could easily crush Yu. Similar to all demons, Asuramaru is manipulative and uses nightmares to consume the one he possesses in order to take over his host's body. At creating a contract with Yu, he interrupts his host's dreams every night with visions of Mika asking why he left them to die.

entries.name: Mitsuba Sangū
entries.content:
She is the younger sister of Aoi Sangū and was a special duty second lieutenant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. Mitsuba became the fifth member of Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company.
Mitsuba Sangū Appearance = She has long blonde hair tied up in pigtails on either side of her head and large violet eyes. Mitsuba is noted to have a curvaceous figure.
For clothing Mitsuba wears the standard JIDA uniform which consists of a long-sleeved black coat with a standing collar which has a red bow tie around it and has her sleeves rolled up. The coat has two rows of gold buttons on the front, light green details including the shoulder epaulettes which has a Sam Browne belt passing diagonally over her right shoulder. Wearing white gloves, she also has a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. She also wears the standard black skirt with black shorts underneath and knee-high black boots. She sometimes wears the black cape.
Mitsuba Sangū Personality =
Making her feelings known, she inveighs against joining a group of new recruits and expresses further indignation upon discovering that Shinoa Hiragi is her squad leader. Mitsuba's tone softens when she believes she has been added to train them.

She can be confrontational, physically as well when she attempted to kick Yu and again when he disobeyed orders. Both instances where when his actions endangered the squad. This is applied well in the battlefield.

Assertive, Mitsuba is aware of the threat they face and speaks at length to relay the dangers. Her contempt towards reckless behaviour such as that seen in Yu stems in part from the loss of her squad. She is serious about her duties and wary of traps.

Placing the safety of others before herself, when Mitsuba was captured by vampires she wanted her squad to retreat. Her caring side was also shown when she tended to Shinoa after she was slapped. She was happy to defend Mika from her own comrades.

entries.name: Shihō Kimizuki
entries.content:
is one of the main male deuteragonists in Seraph of the End and the older brother of Mirai Kimizuki. He is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, as well as Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. After acquiring a pair of cursed gear swords he would assist his squad in exterminating vampires and freeing humans. Kimizuki headed to Shinjuku to defend the city from a vampire invasion force, and then took part in the mission targeting vampire nobles in Nagoya.

Shihō Kimizuki Appearance = He is the tallest member in the Shinoa Squad and has short, messy dark pink hair and reddish-brown eyes. He wears black, thick-framed long rectangular glasses and has two piercings in his left ear.

For clothing Kimizuki is seen wearing his school uniform, a grey gakuran with a standing collar that is black with teal trim. The jacket is unbuttoned as he wears a hoodie underneath.

After he was enlisted into the Moon Demon Company, he wears the standard JIDA uniform which consists of a long-sleeved black coat with light green details including the shoulder epaulettes which has a brown Sam Browne belt passing diagonally over his right shoulder and two rows of gold buttons on the front. Along with that, he wears a pair of white gloves and a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. He also wears the uniform trousers with two white belts around his right leg and knee-high black boots which goes over his trouser legging.
Shihō Kimizuki Personality =
Initially confrontational, Kimizuki picked a fight with Yu and the aggression was maintained after seeing him again. Guren commented that Kimizuki was starting to seem friendly and less volatile. Shinoa observes that Kimizuki attacked Yu to test his ability and maintain his alpha dominance over the students.

As a student, Shihō is shown to be a very diligent and smart, scoring 100% in his Latin, English, and Japanese tests. When he was first introduced in the story, he was not even listening to class, and instead was sleeping with a book covering his face with his legs resting on the chair in front of him. Feeling he is a star student of his class, Kimizuki is not afraid to remind other people of what he has accomplished.

His practical talents include being able to fix and drive cars, and Kimizuki is shown to be an excellent cook as well. He follows directions such as attacking a demon that a team member had turned into, and complied with Shinoa's order to swerve the car for something he could not see. Kimizuki is sure of his abilities in combat, and told Yu they could handle a squad of vampires.

Kimizuki's capabilities and doing what is expected of him and beyond is part of what enables him to effectively deal with problems. He also supports team members whether it is defending them from attack, to doing what he can to rescue them. One instance was using the Devil's Coffin, an attacking ability to instead save Yu and simultaneously deal with his demon possession problem.

entries.name: Shūsaku Iwasaki
entries.content:
He was a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Makoto Narumi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. (He is dead).
Shūsaku Iwasaki Apperance = Shūsaku has medium length purple hair with bangs and blue eyes.

He wears the standard JIDA uniform which consists of a long-sleeved black coat with light green details including the

shoulder epaulettes
which had a brown

Sam Browne belt
passing diagonally over his right shoulder and two rows of gold buttons on the front. Along with that, he wore a pair of white gloves and a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. He also wore the uniform trousers and knee-high black boots which goes over his trouser's leggings.

Shūsaku Iwasaki personaly = he was quiet and focused,wisdom and courage.

entries.name: Rika Inoue
entries.content:
She was a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Makoto Narumi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. (She is dead).

Rika Inoue apperance = Rika had long blonde hair pulled into two fluffy ponytails with long reddish-rose ribbons holding them in place. She had bangs that are longer on the sides. She wore a hair clip in her bangs, and she wore a reddish-rose choker with a pink butterfly accessory. She had blue eyes.

Her JIDA uniform consisted of a long-sleeved black coat with light green details including the

shoulder epaulettes
and two rows of gold buttons on the front; she had her sleeves rolled up. She left the top of the jacket unbuttoned which showed some of her cleavage. Along with that, she wore a white web belt with a gold waist-plate. She wore a an extra-short uniform skirt and knee-high black boots. She wore a pink bracelet on her left wrist.

Rika Inoue personality = Rika had a free-spirited personality which could be seen from her gal-ish tone and how she wore her uniform.

She took the initiative to be a mood maker, like exchanging high-five with others, and was always contributing to improve the linkage of the squad. She was shown to care a lot about her squad members, even going as far as to threaten Shinoa when they were killed.

entries.name: Yayoi Endō
entries.content:
She was a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Makoto Narumi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. (She is dead).

Yayoi Endō personality = She is the kind-hearted peace keeper of the belligerent Narumi squad, and was relied on to provide intel regarding Lucal Wesker's movements, which she done effectively.

Contrary to her quiet looks, she was brave and had a firm attitude when confronting vampires, taking part in group attacks and attacking gallantly by herself.

entries.name: Shinya Hīragi
entries.content:
as a member of Guren's squad. He is a Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. He was chosen to marry Mahiru Hīragi and was adopted by the Hīragi Family. Although he has high capacity of spellcraft from since childhood, Shinya is not comfortable about being with the Hīragi family. However, he is good friends with Guren Ichinose, who also holds the same intention against them.

Shinya Hīragi apperance = Shinya is a tall, young man with medium length white hair with bangs and blue eyes.



Shinya Hīragi personality = Shinya is shown to be a gentle and cool man. He does not get angry easily, even when being insulted by Seishirō. He is seen smiling pleasantly all the time, even in tough spots, shown in the battle of Nagoya with Crowley. He has a lighthearted and breezy personality, often joking around Guren, and seems to be relaxed even during missions, as seen where he calmly teaches Yoichi the role of a sniper.

Shinya is shown to be very loyal to his friends, such as joining Guren in the battle in Nagoya, despite recognizing that it is a suicide mission. He is shown to put a lot of trust in his closest friends, such as Guren, and is deeply shocked when Guren is revealed to be a Namanari. Along with that, unlike most Hīragi, he lacks any superiority complex, as he has been seen to treat others kindly and politely. Another show of this was how he never shunned Shinoa unlike any other member of the family, as he treated her kindly and even seemed to truly care for her, aiding in saving her during the Apocalypse and later on forgiving her rescue of Mikaela. Shinya also holds his morals firmly above his desires, being deeply enraged at Guren when the latter killed many of his own comrades and showing nothing but disgust at Guren's nonchalant dismissal even as he justified it as being to fulfil both of their dreams.

A trait that Shinya possesses is that he is very observant and perceptive, picking out tiny reactions on Guren's face and is able to easily grasp the latter's emotions. He also is able to piece together an idea on what Guren is hiding just by observing his movements and facial expressions.

However, Shinya's lighthearted personality and his charming smile is only a facade, a defense mechanism. Since he was put in an arena-styled environment as a child, where young boys have to battle to death, he began to mask his fears and insecurities in order to help him endure the harsh training. Shinya's constant smile is also there to fool adversaries into letting their guards down, so he could strike at the right moment. Once his mask is gone, he is shown to be more blunt and even somewhat masochistic, thinking about how his own death will play out when Mahiru rejected him.

entries.name: Hiragi Family
entries.content:
The Hīragi Family exists in Seraph of the End as the most powerful family in Japan. Members are the current leaders of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. They managed to control the JIDA through nepotism and having its family members be skilled and powerful fighters and magic users. As a consequence, this leads to power struggles which causes discomfort among its members, particularly Guren and Shinoa. The family is noted as "scary" by many, including Mitsuba and even Shinoa, who is a Hīragi herself.

AFFILIATION =
Order of the Imperial Demons,
Japanese Imperial Demon Army,
First Shibuya High School.
ENEMY =
Hyakuya Sect,
Vampires.


The Hīragis have a pedigree of 1,200 years. They became the top religious organization known as the Order of the Imperial Demons and one of the centers of Japan's magical society.[2]

Several centuries ago, the Hīragi family developed impressive spell-casting abilities and were successful enough to create branch families that would continue to serve them over centuries. These branch families would also have lesser families serving them.

Family branches = Jūjō Clan
One of the oldest and most powerful families supporting the Hīragi family.[4]

The members of this family are recognized for their red hair. According to legend, an ancestor of the family, Tohito Jūjō, single-handedly defeated a powerful demon. However, a curse was placed on the bloodline. Since then, all Jūjō descendants were born with red hair.[4]

The Jūjō use magic to power themselves up physically and push their bodies to their limits. They are famed as warriors and soldiers because of this. Many of them serve as guards or assassins.

500 years prior to the series, the Ichinose family served as the top family under the Hīragi. However, both the first and second sons of the Hīragi family fell in love with the daughter of the Ichinose family. The second son won her love. In retaliation, the first son castrated the second son and raped the Ichinose daughter, impregnating her with his child. Splitting off from the main family, they formed the Order of the Imperial Moon.[5]

Although the first son could have annihilated the Ichinose at any time, he chose to let them live on and suffer humiliation.[5] This maltreatment continues into the Catastrophe light novels and even the Vampire Reign manga.

When it came to using a blade, the Ichinoses rivalled even the Hīragi clan itself. The Ichinose Clan had split off from the Hīragi clan around 500 years ago, forming the Order of the Imperial Moon.

entries.name: Kureto Hīragi
entries.content:
Race human.
Kureto is the Lieutenant General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army whose goal is to exterminate all the vampires in Japan. Of all the family houses, he is a member of the strongest one, the Hīragi Family. Tended to by Aoi Sangū, he has designs on establishing control over the surviving humans on the planet.

Before the world ended, Kureto's experiences in First Shibuya High School are detailed in the prequel Seraph of the End: Guren Ichinose: Catastrophe at Sixteen light novel series, and its own manga adaption. He seeks to find the person who is manipulating the Hīragi family. Not fully aware of events to come, Kureto grapples with the Hyakuya Sect rising to prominence. Around the time it was developed, Kureto would acquire the Cursed Gear sword, Raimeiki.

Establishing control over Japan in the ruined world, although leading army forces against vampires, Kureto's rampant paranoia and need to interrogate humans under him to check for traitors no matter how unlikely, in his view leaves him one step ahead. Working with Guren Ichinose he fuels a seraph experiment to assist in the war against those he has no use for. Having become the head of the Hīragi Family by murdering his own father, Tenri Hīragi, he would be targeted for possession by Shikama Dōji.

Kureto Hīragi apperance = He is a tall, young man with short black hair and reddish brown eyes. He has thick eyebrows that are slightly angled up at the ends. During his time throughout First Shibuya High School, his hair was somewhat more kept, and notably more lighter on top. Where the centre of his fringe was slightly longer in the centre, from the angle of his eyebrows, and the length in sections of his hair, it was generally the case there was an equal distance between them.

The uniform worn on the premises consisted of a long-sleeved, and raised collar jacket. There were featured red sections such as on the end of the sleeves, and in the collar area. An emblem was emblazoned on the left chest area. Relatively large buttons fastened the jacket together. This was the same navy blue like color as the pants he wore. On other occasions, Kureto wore a short-sleeved white shirt. Again, it featured a raised collar, was buttoned with all of them done up, and bore an emblem.

As an adult, Kureto continues wearing uniform based attire. The standard Japanese Imperial Demon Army uniform is worn which consists of a black tailcoat with red details including the

shoulder epaulettes
with gold trim on each of the sides. Two rows of gold buttons are on the front of the tailcoat. An

aiguillette
placed on the right shoulder is connected to just under the collar, which features a crescent moon decoration, specifically a waxing crescent moon design.

The same black colored uniform trousers are worn. Around Kureto's waist he wears a relatively large web belt. Parallel white lines running horizontally across the top and bottom of the belt, where a black section is in the middle of them. The belt buckle is a prominent appearing golden circular buckle, of which the prongs are not visible. Along with that, Kureto wears a pair of white gloves, an armband on his left arm. In addition, Kureto wears black shoes.



Kureto Hīragi personality = Arrogant and powerful from an early age, Kureto does not tolerate any disrespect, perceived or real, from lower-rank families. He is manipulative, ruthless, and treacherous (Shinoa describes him as a "monster"), and will not hesitate to abandon his comrades if he no longer finds them useful. In fact, he finds that being able to abandon one's own friends as a strength. Expecting everyone to submit to him with absolute loyalty, Kureto would even go so far as to threaten them to do his work. As such, Kureto is very confident with himself, his plans and his actions. Some of the basis for this is to sustain that Hiragi clan he was raised in.

entries.name: Seishirō Hīragi
entries.content:
He is a person of influence as a Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of the prestigious Hīragi Family.

Apperance Seishirō Hīragi = He has black and dark grey hair styled in a Mohawk. Additionally, he has thick, short eyebrows, and narrow red eyes.



Seishirō Hīragi personality = Seishirō is rude and has an offensive attitude towards the lower branch families, as shown by his continual disrespect towards Guren Ichinose, even when Guren became Kureto's follower.

He acts very proud, but he uses his father's power and name for protection. Although he feels angry when his father was insulted, he begged for his life when Kureto threatened him.

As both Kureto and Mahiru noted, despite his bravado, in the end Seishirō is nothing but an incompetent useless coward who while acting strong and cruel, has never stood on the front lines, causing both of them to show nothing but utter disgust and no respect at all to him. He has a inferiority complex about Kureto and secretly plans to outwit him someday.

entries.name: Aoi Sangū
entries.content:
Race human.
She is the older sister of Mitsuba Sangū and the servant of Kureto Hīragi who is also part of the Sangū family, one of the three prodigious families serving the Hīragi Family.




Aoi Sangū apperance = Aoi appears like a taller and more buxom Mitsuba Sangū with straight shoulder length blonde hair (which is lighter than Mitsuba's hair color) pulled into pigtails, which were on the back of her hair than to the sides, unlike Mitsuba; her bangs are parted on the right, which were held them in place with two hair clips. She has purple eyes as well. She wore the First Shibuya High school uniform, a

sailor fuku
which consists of a blouse with red trim around the collar with a grayish blue sailor-style collar which also has red trim and a similarly colored skirt with a belt. The red uniform ribbon which is thinner than normal sailor fuku, is attached to the bottom right end of the collar. The school's emblem is located on the right breast. She wears thigh length grayish blue stockings and dark blue dress shoes along with it.





Aoi Sangū personality = Aoi would usually appear at Kureto Hīragi's side as his personal aide. Possessing a good head on her shoulders, with a calm countenance when assessing every situation and a great degree of vigilance, she has her master’s complete trust. Aoi is stoic, serious, and appears to follow his every order without hesitation, no matter how gruesome or how heartless it is. She also appears to have no qualms in killing, shown when she annihilated Seishirō's bodyguards.

entries.name: Mito Jūjō
entries.content:
Race human.

is a member of Guren's squad and the Jūjō family, one of the three prodigious clans that serve the Hīragi Family. she is a colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.

Mito Jūjō apperance = Guren describes Mito as having distinctively beautiful crimson-red hair, fiercely slanted almond-shaped eyes (which are purple), and pale milky skin.

Mito wore the female Imperial Demon special forces combat uniform, which was a long-sleeved double-breasted black coat with shoulder epaulettes and two rows of buttons, a ribbon tied around the neck, a wide white belt with a circular buckle, white gloves, knee-high black boots.



Mito Jūjō personality = Mito is the classic tsundere Ojōsama. She is shown to have good manners and etiquette, such as asking for her teacher to announce Shigure as the winner in their sparring match instead of herself, when she knocked down Shigure even though Shigure had already won the fight. She is not afraid to recognize and praise the strength of other people, such as Shigure and Guren.

Mito, like her red hair, has a fiery temper, such as yelling at Guren in their entrance ceremony, and ambushing Guren when he walks out of the gym. However, beneath her temper, lies someone who wishes that she could break free from her family. Mito finds freedom in being one of Guren's friends, and struggles to uphold her family image while enjoying her life at the same time.

Mito is also shown to be quite blunt, berating Shinoa's squad heavily after their spar. She takes rules and formation very seriously, such as when Shinoa's squad arrived late, and their cocky behavior.

is a member of Guren's squad and of the Goshi family, one of three prodigious clans serving the Hīragi Family. 

he is a colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and part of the Moon Demon Company.

Norito Goshi apperance = Norito is a tall, young man with bleach-blond hair tied in a short ponytail and a small goatee. He has mischievous, sleepy brown eyes.He wears the standard JIDA uniform which consists of a long-sleeved black coat with light green details including the

shoulder epaulettes

Sam Browne belt

Norito Goshi personality = Norito is a flirty man, who enjoys teasing Guren's two retainers. He often makes perverted jokes, such as how he wants Sayuri to hold him in a headlock so his head is right up in her breasts.

His behavior apparently pisses Guren off most of the time, which is evident from Guren kicking Norito instead of Shinya, or ordering his retainers to beat him up.

Being part of the prestigious Goshi family, Norito is proud of his lineage and skills. However, he has come to respect Guren's strength as the two bonded in their school days.

entries.name: Tenri Hīragi
entries.content:
Race human.(he is dead).
was the General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and the former leader of the Hīragi Family. 
He was know how the stronger,however he was never shown fighting. His strength was purely from tales of which describe him beating the previous vampire Queen and he also took out most of the nobles.

Tenri Hīragi apperance = Tenri had a large build and ashen hair similar to Mahiru and Shinoa and amber eyes. The right side of his face had curse marks, and covered over by a black patch, which goes over his eye, the right side of his head, and connects to his neck. His right shoulder and neck appears to be mechanical.

In the Catastrophe manga, he did not yet wear an eye patch or anything that looked mechanical. He was not seen as using a cane.

He wore the JIDA uniform which consists of a long-sleeved black coat with red details, two rows of gold buttons and a green

Sam Browne belt
passing diagonally over his right shoulder. Over this is a maroon military overcoat with

shoulder epaulettes
which have a gold bullion fringe along with an

aiguillette
on his left shoulder. He also wore a pair of white gloves and the uniform trousers with black shoes.

Tenri Hīragi Personality = Personality
Tenri was best described as a proud and harsh individual. Like the rest of the Hīragi family (with the exception of Shinoa and Mahiru), he looks down on lower houses and made sure that they knew their place. He did not hesitate to use violence or cruelty and taunted Guren about forcing his father, Sakae Ichinose, to dance naked in front of them prior to having Sakae beheaded.

Idealistically, he strongly believed in the concept of survival of the fittest. Due to the weight of this savage principle he abided by, he would have seen that the strong lived and the weak died. He did not especially value his children's lives either and even gave Guren permission to kill Seishirō because he was fooled by Guren.

Furthermore, Tenri was not at all happy with Guren's defiant attitude.

As seen in his last moments, Tenri has showcased that he still retains a level of empathy and regret for his actions, this is seen where he admitted that he was jealous of his son Kureto for managing to defeat him while retaining his "humanity" and implied that he harbored some regret for having killed his siblings to become the "king".

entries.name: Mahiru Hīragi
entries.content:
Race demon (she was human and also she was vampire). Parted from Noya, active as herself.
